classification: descriptive single-device product gate; not a relevance experiment and not evidence of cross-device compatibility
purpose: Measure the real public browser-static-v4 experience before making the mode visible without a URL opt-in.

environment.execution: headless=new with a fresh temporary user-data directory
environment.machine: the current Apple Mac; hardware, OS, browser and adapter are recorded at execution
environment.network: the current uncontrolled internet connection; transfer and timing observations are descriptive

interpretation.latency_and_memory: reported descriptively; this first run has no post-hoc pass threshold
interpretation.compatibility: a pass establishes compatibility only for the recorded Mac, Chrome and adapter
interpretation.next_step_if_pass: prepare a visible but still explicit user opt-in with honest cold-download disclosure; do not make semantic search the default
interpretation.next_step_if_fail: keep the URL-only opt-in and fix the observed product blocker without changing frozen retrieval scores

prohibitions: No changes to production, src/core/rank.js or existing retrieval during this gate.
No model or corpus rebuild, inference rerun, score change or tuning.
No human relevance labels or A/B exposure.
No model weights committed to Git.
No compatibility claim beyond the recorded environment.
